meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes, GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 HyperFrames 合成添加安全的关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 HyperFrames 中制作精确的 2D/3D 关键帧动画
copy.tagline_en: Add seek-safe keyframe animations to HyperFrames compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need precise 2D/3D keyframe animations in HyperFrames

howto.what: Claude 会为 HyperFrames 合成编写可定位的 2D/3D 关键帧动画:先确认对象、状态和时长,选最小实现,再写 GSAP/CSS 等关键帧,并用 lint、check、keyframes 命令验证;失败时修源头后重跑最小诊断。
howto.when: 当 HyperFrames 合成需要可定位 2D/3D 关键帧、GSAP/CSS 时间轴等动画能力,或运行 keyframes 诊断时触发。不用于整体场景策略、品牌设计、媒体素材等事务。

say.text: 给这个方块做从 A 点到 B 点、中间停一下的关键帧动画。
say.note: 会生成已注册的可定位 GSAP 时间轴。

say.text: 把所有卡片的弹入做成依次错开的动画。
say.note: 按合成时长和可见状态生成错开的关键帧。

say.text: 跑一遍校验,把我这段主体动画的报错修掉。
say.note: 触发 lint、check、keyframes 等验证流程。

howto.what_en: Claude authors seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes for HyperFrames: identify subject, states, runtime; choose smallest mechanism; write GSAP/CSS keyframes; verify with lint/check/keyframes; fix source and rerun smallest failing diagnostic.
howto.when_en: When a HyperFrames composition needs seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes, GSAP/CSS timelines, or other animation work, or keyframes diagnostics. Not for scene strategy, brand, media, or similar tasks.

say_en.text: Make this box animate from point A to B with a pause in the middle.
say_en.note: Creates a registered, seek-safe GSAP timeline.

say_en.text: Give all cards a staggered pop-in animation.
say_en.note: Uses ordered offsets and composition time.

say_en.text: Run verification and fix the errors in my subject's motion.
